population_contract.historical_seen_status: All 173 DEV images/sessions and 146 excluded FINAL images have historical model/diagnostic exposure. The new TEST partition is frozen for this experiment; it is not globally unseen independent confirmation.

real_split.rule: Stratify sessions by manifest object_type; sort each material by sha256('visibility-curriculum-20261013:'+session); plastic first4 CAL/rest3 TEST and wood first1 CAL/rest1 TEST

CAL.allowed: New threshold/model-policy selection only here; evaluation labels require explicit scoring phase.

TEST.allowed: Read RGB/prediction inputs at inference; read reference/human labels only after new prediction/configuration freeze. No tuning on TEST.

prediction_only_inputs.coordinate_system: Original unpadded image pixel coordinates. xyz=[width,height,depth] in m; points[BASE/N3_SUBPIX] are 9x2 native channel points; center8 is not independent PnP support.

cached_initial_poses.loader: Stream only selected IDs/methods. initial_pose is prediction-derived; do not substitute actual_pose from a newly fitted condition.

targets.reference_type: Existing geometric reconstruction, not independent physical measurement.

evaluation_only_annotations.human_state_native_mapping_rule: Fix one whole-object permutation from frozen N3_SUBPIX baseline corner.branch, then states_native[k]=labels[(id, permutation[k])]. Do not choose a different branch per corner or to improve new scores.

source_training_inputs.source_test_status: Previously evaluated repeatedly; frozen source diagnostic partition, not new independent heldout.

geometry_loader.native_channel_mapping: Uses perm_v4 width/depth role, unique nearest8 canonical projection; max discrepancy<0.05px.

source_training_inputs.known_limit: Pallet cuboid vertical bounding edges may be nonphysical on rounded mesh; virtual corner line intersections are permitted when intended incident physical wires are validated.

required_pose_contract.self_occlusion: Compute from initial RGB-derived pose first, preserve H as an explicit prediction-derived exclusion.

contract_revision_history.initial_split_rule: Sort session names by sha256('visibility-curriculum-20261013:'+session); first5 CAL, remaining4 TEST

initial_CAL.allowed: New threshold/model-policy selection only here; evaluation labels require explicit scoring phase.

initial_TEST.allowed: Read RGB/prediction inputs at inference; read reference/human labels only after new prediction/configuration freeze. No tuning on TEST.
